text:
laura_ae: Heads-up 30 Midtown Finance legal dropped an identity/security questionnaire. Key asks: SAML SSO + attribute mapping, SCIM provisioning (delta preferred), RBAC mapping (nested groups -> roles), domain ownership verification, 12mo audit retention, and customer-managed encryption keys (CMK) for at-rest data. They also want a 3-week POC estimate (10-15 seats, ~40k tokens/day) with option to move to Dedicated if it meets controls.

sam_se: Copy. Do they need user provisioning push only, or do they want inbound group sync too?

laura_ae: Legal: "Inbound group sync required; delta updates; ability to translate nested AD groups into RBAC roles; SCIM latency < 120s for adds/changes."

nina_compliance: A few policy items: 1) Domain verification: they want to restrict accounts to verified domains and block invites outside those domains; 2) Audit retention 12 months; 3) Proof of SOC2 + network encryption. CMK requirement is negotiable if we can show envelope encryption and HSM-backed key wrapping for Hosted for the POC.

sam_se: Tech details from us: Hosted supports SCIM v2 with delta and full sync, supports inbound group sync. We can provide a mapping adapter to flatten nested groups or map via rules. SAML attr mapping example we provide to customers:
```
Assertion: Subject -> NameID: userPrincipalName
Attributes:
  - uid -> username
  - memberOf -> groups
  - title -> job_title
```
We can add regex transforms in mapping layer.

oliver_sre: Audit/logging: Hosted event logs retention default 90 days. We have enterprise retention add-on up to 13 months and log export to S3/Cloud Logging. Dedicated/Private gives full control + direct SIEM ingest. TLS1.2+ enforced, and we can produce encryption-in-transit docs. CMK: only for Dedicated and Private currently; Hosted can do envelope with KMS in our cloud provider.

ben_csm: Customer preference? They said they'd rather avoid on-prem unless required, but CMK + 12mo logs may push them to Dedicated. POC objective: validate SSO/SAML login, SCIM delta provisioning for 12 test users + 3 nested groups, RBAC enforcement for model access, and log export to their S3 for ingestion.

sam_se: For RBAC: we support attribute-based mapping and role assignment rules. Example policy we can demo:
```
if groups contains "risk_ops" then grant role:read_only_analyst
if department == "trading" then grant role:deploy_model_basic
```
Model-level ACLs: tag models and bind allow-lists or deny-lists per role.

nina_compliance: Also need to confirm key lifecycle ops: rotation window, who holds the CMK (customer vs provider), and ability to rotate without downtime. They asked for ATO-ish language; I can put together a 1-page controls summary.

opsbot: config:midtown-scim-samples uploaded to https://redwood.internal/configs/midtown-poc (internal)

laura_ae: Pricing: they want a POC quote and a committed Dedicated baseline for production at 4 GPUs. Can finance give ballpark? Also want to know setup fees for Private if they consider that route.

sam_se: Preliminary numbers: Dedicated 4x A100-equivalent pool ~ $45k/month baseline (region + support vary). Private onboarding one-time engineering/setup fee ~ $60k-120k depending on infra complexity + monthly platform license $10k/mo baseline. POC: we typically cover initial weeks under SP credits or low-rate trial; we can offer a 3-week hosted POC with extended logging trial if NDA signed. I'll confirm exact quotes with finance.

ben_csm: I'll draft the acceptance criteria doc (pass/fail criteria for provisioning, RBAC, logs, and latency) and share with Midtown.

laura_ae: Legal asked for a short security cover note to attach to their questionnaire. Nina, can you provide that?

nina_compliance: Yup. I'll produce a 1-page controls summary (SOC2, TLS, at-rest encryption, KMS/CMK options, log export, SIEM integration) and sample language for their procurement by EOD.

sam_se: For demo: can we run a quick end-to-end showing SAML sign-on + SCIM delta + RBAC role enforcement tomorrow at 11am ET? I'll prepare a test tenant with 15 users and nested groups.

oliver_sre: I'll standby to enable log export to S3 and flip the retention to enterprise trial for the demo.

laura_ae: Great. I'll reply to Midtown to request IdP metadata and the official domain list, and ask them to sign NDA to unlock credits. Also asking them to confirm which models should be restricted for the POC.

ben_csm: I'll set up a shared spreadsheet with test users and acceptance checks and link it here once ready.

laura_ae: Closing loop 30 will post NDA and demo invite here when available. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
